how drones and missiles flew toward the capital

By the 3rd and 4th waves, the AFU launched their main strike UAVs, which approached Moscow from the west, south, and east. And in coordination with them, the AFU also launched 10 Flamingo cruise missiles, 9 of which were shot down before reaching Moscow.

As a result of the entire attack, according to the latest data, air defense units recorded no fewer than 1,300 unmanned aircraft, of which only 11 could not be shot down. Both air defense systems and army and fighter aviation participated in the defense.
